---
title: "Workshop Materials"
format: html
---

Welcome to SWAPER's Workshop repository. The latest lectures will be updated here.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(readxl)

data <- read_excel("data_workshop.xlsx", sheet = 1)

data_processed <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Date = format(as.Date(Dates), "%Y-%m-%d"), 
    Access = paste0('<a href="../documents/workshop/', Filename, '" target="_blank" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary">Link</a>')
  ) %>%
  select(Date, Title, Authors, Expertise, Access)

datatable(data_processed, 
          escape = FALSE, 
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 10,
            autoWidth = TRUE,
            language = list(search = "Search here:")
          ))
```
